clips.title: The story
paras: This investigation unearths a forgotten chapter in the dark tale of Stalvan Mistmantle. A dusty, unsent letter pulled from a neglected footlocker in Moonbrook provides tangible proof of where he stayed before his vanished trail turned cold, leading back to Darkshire's records.

While tracking down the history of Stalvan Mistmantle, an old footlocker tucked away in Moonbrook yields a vital piece of the puzzle: a dusty, unsent letter. Moonbrook, once a thriving agricultural settlement, fell into ruin and now teems with outlaws and restless specters. Stalvan's presence here was brief enough to escape common memory, but this neglected missive definitively places him in the hamlet.

Delivering the letter back across the border to Darkshire gives Clerk Daltry the missing documentation he needs. While Daltry finds it peculiar that the letter was never mailed, the evidence is indisputable. With the Moonbrook connection verified, the bureaucratic paper trail can finally guide the investigation toward where Stalvan fled next.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, I remember you. You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow. Did you ever find what you were looking for?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Interesting. So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all. It is rather odd the letter never got delivered. Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.
